svg.title: Quest board: one main quest and five side quests
svg.desc: A quest board of six notices: MainQuest, Real life, rendered as an RPG: a gamified productivity app (live at www.mainquest.net); SlateNode, Writer-first editor with AI in the margin, as proposals (private, in progress); Overload, Progressive-overload gym tracker (private, in progress); saas-base, Production-ready SaaS starter: auth, billing, analytics, email (private, in progress); meibun, Just a rather very intelligent system: a personal assistant stack (private, in progress); Agents Office, An isometric 3D office where AI agents do the work (private, in progress).
